title: Ethereal Rose Vision
description: A surreal portrait of a woman with striking blue eyes and pale skin, her face partially obscured by large pale yellow roses. Her hair merges with translucent, layered imagery including a hooded figure surrounded by glowing golden spirals, overlapping with diagonal beams of yellow and green light against a dark teal and purple background.
prompt: surreal double exposure portrait of a young woman with pale skin and intense blue eyes, large pale yellow roses growing from her hair and face, layered with a translucent hooded figure and glowing golden spiral patterns, dramatic diagonal beams of yellow and green light cutting across a dark teal and purple background, ethereal and mystical atmosphere, painterly digital art style
